newsitem.title: CHINA: China boosts investment in poorest areas.
newsitem.headline: China boosts investment in poorest areas.

text.p: China has boosted fixed asset investment in its poorest western regions since the start of 1997, the China Securities said on Friday.
Fixed asset investment in these regions grew 27.9 percent year-on-year in the first five months, it said, adding that the growth rate was the highest of any region in China.
Investment rose 13 percent year-on-year in China's wealthier eastern regions in the first five months, it said. Growth in central China was 10.6 percent.
Overall fixed asset investment rose 14 percent in the first five months compared with the same 1996 period, the newspaper said.
China's economic reform in the past 18 years has transformed most of the coastal regions from economic backwater to powerhouses, but the central and western parts of the country lag far behind.
